business: Builder marketplace (working name not chosen): flat renovation first. ASSUMED TEST BUYER: a private owner of an apartment in a large Russian-speaking city who wants a flat renovation done. City, country and job type are not fixed in idea.md; this profile is an assumption, not customer data.
target: Private apartment owner in a large Russian-speaking city, planning a flat renovation and not yet sure who to hire
currency: RUB, annual household income (assumed ranges, not market data)

behaviours.name: Gets three quotes before choosing
behaviours.how: Asks several crews for prices, then compares the numbers and little else.

behaviours.name: Price-first
behaviours.how: Picks the cheapest bid unless something obvious rules it out.

behaviours.name: Reads reviews, slow to trust
behaviours.how: Checks reviews and ratings before contacting anyone, and distrusts anything that looks like an ad.

behaviours.name: Referral-led
behaviours.how: Asks friends and neighbours for a crew they have used and trust.

behaviours.name: Hands-off
behaviours.how: Wants one person to manage the whole job so they do not have to chase the crew.

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: Had a renovation go badly over money or deadlines and now plans around that.

behaviours.name: Already has a crew
behaviours.how: Mostly has someone in mind and only wants the paperwork and payment handled.

objections: Why pay a platform on top of what the builder charges?
Who checks that the builder is any good?
Bids from different firms never describe the same work, so how do I compare them?
If the work goes wrong halfway, will the platform actually help me?
I would rather pay the crew directly and avoid the middleman
I don't know yet whether the platform's fee is worth it, since the price is not stated
habits: your flat needs new floors, the kitchen and the bathroom redone
a friend's renovation ran over budget and dragged on for months
you have only ever hired builders through word of mouth
you are busy at work and cannot spend evenings chasing a crew
